name: Jian Sin Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Jian Sin Industrial Co., Ltd. is a company that specializes in the global production and distribution of steel and cast aluminum wheels, serving both its domestic market in Taiwan and international clients. Established in 1978, this enterprise is headquartered in Changhua, Taiwan. The company officially adopted its current name, Jian Sin Industrial Co., Ltd., in July 2015, having previously been known as Yuan Feng Industrial Co. Ltd.
